'''Gufrin''' is a [[Redarms]] sergeant.{{ref/book|13|8}}

==Appearance==

He is a sturdy, broad-shouldered man. Not terribly bright, but keen eyed.

==Activities==
He informs [[Mat]] that all three Aes Sedai had returned to the camp while Mat was away.
